# kit-prismantis

[prismantis](https://github.com/NahumLitvin/prismantis) is a third-party Claude Code plugin (MIT) that redraws Claude's replies in color: tables, code, mermaid diagrams, charts and copy buttons, in selectable themes. It needs Claude Code 2.1.287 or later. Its default `diagramHints` option adds about 630 tokens to each prompt.

The tip state lives in `~/.agentkit/state.json` and changes only through the hook adapter: `node ".agentkit/hooks/adapter.cjs" claude flag prismantis <installed|remind-off|remind-on>`, run from the project root. Do not edit the state file directly.

1. Ask the user (AskUserQuestion) whether to install prismantis now, stating the requirement and the token cost above.
2. **Install**: follow the upstream README so the latest release is installed; never pin a version.
   - Run `claude plugin marketplace list`. If no `prismantis` marketplace is listed, run `claude plugin marketplace add NahumLitvin/prismantis`; otherwise run `claude plugin marketplace update prismantis`.
   - Run `claude plugin install prismantis@prismantis`, then confirm it appears in `claude plugin list`.
   - On success, run the `installed` flag and tell the user to run `/reload`, then `/prismantis setup` to pick a theme.
   - If a command is blocked or fails (network, permissions), show the user the two commands to run themselves and do not set the flag; the next Claude startup detects the installed plugin and stops the tip.
3. **Decline**: ask whether to keep receiving the tip when Claude starts. If not, run the `remind-off` flag. If yes, change nothing. If the user later wants the tip back, run the `remind-on` flag.
4. Report the outcome in one line.
